title: Bethesda.net — Starfield
desc: Patch notes, DLC announcements, and the first word on anything new before anyone else has written about it.

title: Starfield Wiki (UESP)
desc: Run by the same team behind the long-running Elder Scrolls and Fallout wikis — thorough, low on clutter, and usually right.

title: r/Starfield
desc: Where players actually argue about builds, bugs, and whether the Red Mile is worth the entry fee.

title: Starfield on Steam
desc: Reviews, update history, and the DLC storefront in one place if you're playing on PC.

title: Nexus Mods — Starfield
desc: The actual home of PC modding for the game, from quality-of-life tweaks to entire new star systems.

title: Xbox Wire — Starfield
desc: First-party breakdowns of new mechanics, written by the people who shipped them — the Incursions explainer is a good one.
